decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - Details of the balustrading to the roof terraces of the
    development hereby approved, including materials and
    treatment, shall be submitted to the local planning
    authority and approved in writing prior to the development
    commencing.

Condition : 2 - Details of the new entrance doors to the north-west
    elevation of the development hereby approved, including
    design, materials and finishes, shall be submitted to the
    local Planning Authority and approved in writing prior to
    the development commencing.

Condition : 3 - All new external work shall be carried out in materials that resemble, as closely as possible, in colour and texture those of the existing building, unless otherwise specified in the approved application.

Reason: To safeguard the appearance of the premises and the character of the immediate area in accordance with the requirements of policies EN1 and EN13 [and EN31 if in a CA] of the London Borough of Camden Unitary Development Plan 2000.

Condition : 4 - To ensure that the Council may be satisfied with the
    external appearance of the building in accordance with the
    requirements of policies EN1, EN16 & EN33 of the London
    Borough of Camden Unitary Development Plan 2000.

Condition : 5 - To ensure that the Council may be satisfied with the
    external appearance of the building in accordance with the
    requirements of policies EN1, EN16 & EN33 of the London
    Borough of Camden Unitary Development Plan 2000.

Condition : 6 - To ensure that the Council may be satisfied with the
    external appearance of the building in accordance with the
    requirements of policies EN1, EN16 & EN33 of the London
    Borough of Camden Unitary Development Plan 2000.

Condition : 7 - You are informed that any proposal(s) for subsequent
    adopted Unitary Development Plan.
    change(s) of use of the remaining office accommodation for
    residential purposes will, subject to being acceptable in
    terms of other policies of the Unitary Development Plan, be
    granted only in conjunction with a legal agreement being
    entered into between the Council and the applicant requiring
    that the residential accommodation provided be affordable,
    or that an acceptable contribution be made in lieu to the
    Council. This is in order to comply with policy HG14 of the

Condition : 8 - Prior to the implementation of the development, the
    applicant is requested to contact the Council's
    Transportation Engineering Team (Festus Agwu-Jones), to
    arrange for the payment for and the installation of one
    cycle stand on the public highway outside the premises or in
    the local area.

Condition : 9 - Your attention is drawn to the fact that there is a separate
    legal agreement with the Council which relates to the
    development for which this permission is granted.
description:
Change of use of existing first, second, third and fourth
floors from office use (Class B1) to residential to provide
13 flats (Class C3) involving works of conversion and
elevational changes,
as shown by drawing numbers 2060/1, 2060/2, 2060/3SWSW,
2060/4-13, 2060/15, 2060/16C, 2060/17B, 2060/18B, 2060/19C,
2060/20C, 2060/21B & 2060/23-27.
